site_name: Amazon Village Place Technology Park, 14495 John Marshall Hwy, Gainesville, VA 20155
verification: Refused on session review (2026-11-11). The county layer lists all four Village Place buildings as Under Construction with no occupancy date (edits of 2026-02 and 2026-08), but the same records carry about 250,000 sq ft of taxed building area each, and Virginia DEQ lists the air registration at this address (74277, IAD-195/196/197/198) as Operating, a status DEQ distinguishes from Planned and Under Construction. Two government records disagree, so no status is applied. Verifier's finding, not applied: The researcher's doubt about which record is 14495 is resolved: the county layer has a record with that exact address (Bldg 4, permit case BLD2023-01296). All four Village Place Technology Park buildings show BuildingStatus 'Under Construction', PermitStatus 'Issued', YearBuilt null, OCCDate null. page_date is the 14495 record's LastEditDate (epoch 1770021947000, which I converted by hand to 2026-02-02); Bldg 1 (14435) was last edited 2026-08-06 (epoch 1786038256000) and is still Under Construction. The same layer does fill Year Built and Occupancy Date for finished Amazon buildings farther along John Marshall Hwy (e.g. 15445, occupancy 2024-11-05), so empty fields here are informative. Caveats: (1) the building permits date from 2023, so a status lag in the county layer is possible; this is inference, not verified. (2) The researcher's note of a DEQ air permit labelled operating on an aggregator could not be checked: the Virginia DEQ data-center permit page returned 403 and aggregators are not evidence. An air permit for generators would not by itself establish that the building is occupied. Confidence medium, not high, for those two reasons. Layer queried 2026-11-11.
